sources.name: Nederland Community Library
sources.notes: Unreachable from here on 6 October 2026: two attempts to fetch https://nederlandlibrary.org/ both failed with a curl connection error before any HTTP status (likely the proxy or the host refusing the connection), so robots.txt and the calendar vendor (LibCal, LibraryCalendar, Communico or other) could not be checked. Web search snippets (townofnederland.colorado.gov press releases) place the library at 200 CO-72 (Highway 72 North), Nederland CO 80466, next to the Community Center, and mention a Summer Reading Program kickoff and a Reading Garden ribbon cutting in 2024. Keep manual until the site can be reached and a feed confirmed. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Corrected 6 October 2026: nederlandlibrary.org does not answer; the library’s live site is https://nederland.colibraries.org/, which the Town’s directory links. The id is kept so nothing that names it breaks. Feed found 10 November 2026: the library's site links its calendar at nederland.libcal.com (Springshare LibCal, one public calendar, id 4818, named 'Nederland Library Community Room'). Its iCal subscription, the feedUrl here, answered 200 text/calendar with 203 VEVENT from October 2026 to September 2027 and parsed with the ingest's own reader: 33 items in 10 November to 9 December and 153 from today onward. The LibCal RSS for the same calendar (https://nederland.libcal.com/rss.php?iid=3657&m=month&cid=4818, 35 items with libcal:date, start, end and location) reads too but covers only the coming month; the page's own RSS link uses cid=-1 and comes back empty. Of the 33, 7 are room bookings titled 'Reserved', 2 are closures (Thanksgiving Day, Black Friday) and 2 are NCL District Board meetings, which is what the excludeTitles added today drop; that leaves 22: Wild Bear Storytime (Tuesdays 10:30), STORYTIME! (Fridays 10:15), Monday Nederland Writers, Sci Fi Book Club (10 Nov and 8 Dec, 7 pm), After-school Makers Club, Parents Night Out (14 Nov), Philosophy Club (17 Nov), Front Range Mycological Society (18 Nov), Adult Makers Club (19 Nov), a women's support circle (1 Dec) and Peak Harmony Holiday music (3 Dec, 6:30 pm). Locations are a room ('Community Room', 'Library Open Areas') or nothing, hence the defaultVenue. Some are other groups' meetings in the library's room, not library programmes. robots.txt allows both feeds for our agent (it disallows only /process_ and asks for a ten-second crawl delay). This entry was already confirmed when the feed was found, so the next ingest will read it; the weekly storytimes and writers' group may want excluding too if the guide lists them as regulars. Left as manual on 10 November 2026 although the feed reads: the entry is already confirmed, so typing it ical would start ingest reading it before the owner has looked at the feed and its filters. Set type to ical to turn it on. Typed ical on 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("yes to Nederland"), so ingest reads it from the next run. Exclusions widened the same day after a dry run staged 52 items in 120 days: the weekly writers' group, the book and philosophy clubs, the storytimes, the radio and makers clubs, committee and staff meetings and closures are kept out, as on the other guides' library feeds, which leaves the talks, workshops, performances and one-off programs.

sources.name: The Mountain-Ear
sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. Weekly Peak to Peak newspaper ('Peak to Peak news since 1977'), a TownNews/BLOX site; home page 200 with sections for Nederland, Eldora, Ward, Gold Hill, Jamestown, Allenspark, Coal Creek Canyon, Lyons, Gilpin County, Black Hawk and Central City, plus Meetings, Police Reports, Music of the Mountains and a Visitor's Guide. The BLOX RSS search endpoint (/search/?f=rss&t=article...) returned 403 from the Varnish cache, and a guessed section URL /news/nederland/ returned 404, so no feed is recorded. Subscription paper; use for leads and attribution only, not core. Looked at again 10 November 2026 for event leads. The paper keeps two weekly roundups, each a story list: https://www.themtnear.com/music-listing/ (Music Listing, 76 in two years, every Thursday) and https://www.themtnear.com/cracker-barrel/ (community events). The stories carry a notice that they are for subscribers, though the 5 November Music Listing came back in full to a plain request; it was read once for leads and is not something to copy. Its Nederland section named Very Nice Brewing (Spork 6 Nov, Ben Melius 7 Nov, David Williams 13 Nov at 5 pm, Concrete Feedback 14 Nov at 5 pm, all already in the guide), Knotted Root (Jazz Jam every Sunday at 5 pm, Whumpf Jam 5 Nov), Covered Wagon (karaoke every Thursday at 8 pm) and Nederland General Store (The Foggy Tops, Sunday 15 November at noon). It also lists Gold Hill Inn, Gold Hill Store, Jamestown Mercantile, Oskar Blues in Lyons and the Gilpin and Black Hawk rooms, which are other towns. The paper's own /calendar/ (Creative Circle Media, with an event-posting form) showed two sponsored Boulder events and 'No events were found'; no iCal or RSS link on it. robots.txt allows these pages (it disallows /calendar/post/ and account paths). A subscription would make the Thursday Music Listing the best single lead sheet for Nederland's bars, which do not keep calendars of their own.

sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. (23 Nov, all day). No venue, category or cost on any of them. robots.txt allows everything. Not recorded as a json source because it cannot be read correctly yet: the site's WordPress time zone is 'UTC+0', so the API labels Denver wall-clock times as UTC. The ingest's reader for this format threw 'Invalid time zone specified: UTC+0' on the page, and its iCal reader took the noon lunch for 5 am. Two ways on: the organization sets its site time zone to Denver, or the reader learns to treat 'UTC+0' on this source as local time. Until then read by hand, four or five listings a month; if it is ever switched on, exclude '^NAS CLOSED' and set defaultVenue to the Senior Lounge at the Community Center.

Once the ice is in, usually December to February, public skate, stick and puck and curling sessions would be several listings a week, read in a browser; ask the rink for its calendar address if that is wanted as a feed.

sources.name: Nederland Middle-Senior High School (BVSD)
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. The school's calendar on Boulder Valley School District's Finalsite site (linked from www.bvsd.org as Nederland Middle-Senior; Nederland Elementary is nee.bvsd.org, not read). The month grid at /about/calendar?cal_date=2026-11-01 answered 200 with 165 event links, most of them the district's day markers repeated per category ('Blue Day', 'No School - Thanksgiving Break', 'Fall conference exchange days - no school') plus a few team dates (HS mountain bike State Championship 31 October to 1 November, HS Basketball optional practice begins 2 November); no public performance or community night was seen for November. robots.txt disallows /fs/, where Finalsite keeps its iCal export, and asks for five seconds between requests, so there is no feed to take; scripts/lib/finalsite-calendar.ts already reads this kind of grid for school sports. Of use for home games and school concerts only, read by hand.

sources.name: Peak to Peak Music Education Association (NedFest)
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. nedfest.org now redirects here, to a page of NedFest performer history headed '2023 NedFest Family Reunion Line-up'; no 2026 or 2027 NedFest date was found. sources.name: The Backdoor Theatre (movies at the Community Center)
sources.defaultVenue: Backdoor Theatre, Nederland Community Center, 750 Highway 72 North
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Nederland's volunteer cinema ('First run movies and more!'), in the Nederland Community Center; its own venue record gives only 'Nederland Community Center, Nederland CO 80466', and the Town's calendar puts the center at 750 Highway 72 North. The old address backdoortheater.org has a broken certificate over https and redirects over http to thebackdoortheatre.org, which is the live site. WordPress with The Events Calendar: the home page is the schedule, /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answered 200 with 10 events on one page, time zone America/Denver, and /events/list/?ical=1 answered text/calendar with the same 10. Nine are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 and all are worth a row, three films each shown Friday 7 pm, Saturday 2 pm and Saturday 7 pm: Sense and Sensibility (13 and 14 November; the Saturday matinee is open caption), Wicker (20 and 21 November) and The Cat in the Hat (27 and 28 November). The tenth is a live show, Circus of Bubbles LIVE! on 2 October 2027. Nothing is posted yet for December, so the theatre enters films about three weeks ahead; expect 9 to 12 screenings a month, or 3 or 4 films if each title is one listing with its showtimes. No regulars, no meetings, no cost or category fields, so no exclusions are needed. Every item is at the theatre, hence the defaultVenue. robots.txt allows the feed paths (it disallows only wp-admin and cart links).

sources.name: Bristlecone Bookshop (author events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The bookshop at 114 E Second Street, Nederland (the page's own address), already a place in the guide. Its Events page is a Squarespace collection: 1 upcoming and 30 past. In 10 November to 10 December there is one item, Poetry Open Mic on Saturday 21 November, 5 to 7 pm ('the last poetry night of the year'), a monthly regular. The weeks before show what it adds when busy: Author Talk with Devon O'Neil on 29 October (with the library), an author event with local author Brenna Jeanneret on 7 November, a book club on 8 November, Story Hour on 25 October. So about two author events a month worth a row, plus the open mic, book club and story hour as regulars. Squarespace's robots.txt allows the page and disallows ?format=ical and ?format=json for every agent, so there is no feed; each event has an ICS link for readers. Read by hand. The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: this page is in the list view, and scripts/lib/feeds/squarespace.ts read 1 item (Poetry Open Mic, 21 Nov, 5 to 7 pm) from a plain fetch of it, which the site's robots.txt allows (it disallows ?format=json, ?view= and /api/, none of which the reader uses). Typed squarespace with the page as its feedUrl; still proposed, so ingest does not read it until the owner confirms it.

sources.name: Nederland Food Pantry (events, Holiday Mountain Market)

Read by hand, about one listing a month; if it is ever fed, exclude 'COLORADO GIVES DAY' and 'Clothing Drive'. The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: this page is in the list view, and scripts/lib/feeds/squarespace.ts read 5 items (Holiday Mountain Market 5 and 6 Dec; two distributions, a clothing drive and Colorado Gives Day, which the exclusions drop) from a plain fetch of it, which the site's robots.txt allows (it disallows ?format=json, ?view= and /api/, none of which the reader uses). Typed squarespace with the page as its feedUrl; still proposed, so ingest does not read it until the owner confirms it.

sources.name: Hub Ned (coworking space event calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026, empty as it stands. Hub Ned is the coworking space in downtown Nederland (www.hubned.com; street address not read) whose community room is let for events after hours; TEENS, Inc. held its Write Night there on 11 November. Its member portal (Proximity) has a public Events page that offers an ICS subscription, the feedUrl here, and an Atom feed at /events/rss. Both answered 200 and both were empty: 0 VEVENT, and the page says 'No upcoming events found', so the Write Night was never entered here. robots.txt allows everything. Zero events dated 10 November to 10 December. Recorded because the feed is real and costs nothing to read, but it adds nothing unless the space starts using it; if it does, expect private bookings to need excluding.

sources.name: Ned Gravel (bike race and training rides)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The gravel race the Town's Community Events page names, with its own WordPress site: the 2026 race was 12 July and registration for the next opens 5 January (its first week reserved for women, BIPOC, non-binary and para athletes). The home page's Events list is this year's monthly training rides from Ned General (10 January, 21 February, 14 March, 11 April, 16 May, a course recon ride 13 June), all past; no 2027 race date is posted yet. Nothing dated 10 November to 10 December. No events plugin or feed seen; robots.txt allows the page with a ten-second crawl delay. Open in January for the 2027 date and the winter training rides, about one listing a month from January to July.
